paragraphs.text: One tenth of a point separated Pontotoc from fourth place in the small varsity non-tumbling game day final at the Mississippi Regional in Jackson. The Warriors finished fifth among seven cheer teams with 77.4 points. McLaurin took fourth with 77.5.

Pontotoc’s 79.4 raw score was second only to Starkville Academy’s 81.1. A two-point deduction dropped the Warriors behind McLaurin, which took no deductions. Starkville Academy won the division, followed by Union at 79.2 and Forrest County Agricultural at 78.5. Myrtle finished sixth with 73.6.

The next date for fans following the state cheer competition is Monday, Nov. 23. The Mississippi High School Activities Association plans to release the competition schedule after 2 p.m. that day. The junior high, junior varsity and varsity cheer competitions are set for Saturday, Dec. 12.
